visual.general_description: Eight panels labeled A to H: four circular endoscopic images, two grayscale contrast radiographs of the colon, and two grayscale axial cross-sectional images.

G and H are grayscale axial cross-sections of the lower trunk showing a vertebral body, bony bands and soft tissue, stacked one above the other at the right. Endoscopic frames carry small burned-in text; no arrows or scale bars are present.
